test_inputs.explanation: The execution log does not expose any concrete filter values (IDs, names, dates, etc.) actually used on the customer grid; all actions are marked as 'unknown'. The only reliable inputs we can infer are the default admin credentials described in the schema: when a login form is present and values are omitted, 'admin' and 'password123' are used. These values will allow another tester to reach the same admin customer page URL shown in the trace (http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/customer/). No other parameters (entity_id_from/to, name, email, group_id, etc.) can be grounded from the provided trace, so they are left unset.
